findings.evidence: If IndexedPlanSearchService contains a second similarity query that calls _execute_query without vector_limit (e.g. a neighbour or dedup lookup), it still runs with pgvector's default ef_search=40; the diff only routes _run_vector through the tuning, so verify no such internal caller exists.
findings.title: Any other <=> query in the plan service would keep default ef_search

findings.title: extra_clauses inserted before session in non-keyword-only signatures

findings.evidence: _parse_version('0.8') yields (0, 8) and (0, 8) >= (0, 8, 0) is False, so a patch-less extversion would silently skip iterative_scan; real pgvector extversions are always x.y.z, so this is a defensive edge only.
findings.title: Short extversion string would read as below 0.8

findings.title: Version verdict cached for the process lifetime
